text: An agent's effective system prompt comes from its CLAUDE.md (built by buildAgentClaudeMd in orchestrator/orchestrator.js), not AGENT-PROMPT.md directly; AGENT-PROMPT.md is the prompt source that gets composed in.

Code Reviewer applies exactly one of 'ready-to-merge' / 'revisions-required' per PR; the 'ready-to-merge' label already exists in 314092_agent-execution-environment (green), 'revisions-required' does not yet exist.

When gh-as-agent pr fails with HTTP 409 (orchestrator gh not authenticated), the branch push has usually already succeeded; verify with git ls-remote then open the PR directly via 'gh pr create --repo <owner/repo> --head <branch>' using the agent's own GH_TOKEN.

Before starting a ready-labeled issue, check for an existing branch (git ls-remote | grep <issue#>) and PR (gh pr list --search '<issue#> in:title'); a concurrent/prior run of the same scheduled task often already did the work — verify & finish (e.g. set ready-for-review label) rather than duplicate.
